title: MemPalace: Efficient Infinite Memory Compression for LLMs
summary: A local-first AI memory system that uses a zero-LLM inference write path and hierarchical storage to maintain verbatim-first long-term context. It employs a custom compression dialect called AAAK to achieve 30x data density for LLM readability.
research_notes: Co-created by actress Milla Jovovich and developer Ben Sigman; notable for avoiding the 'summarization drift' found in other AI memory systems.

evolution.summary: Evolved from a viral GitHub repository to a full framework with a technical arXiv paper and Model Context Protocol (MCP) support. The v3.x update introduced the AAAK compression dialect and enhanced local-first performance.
